verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud-backed AI coding workbench, but the evidence shows no option to choose a storage region or jurisdiction. The `ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR` variable only sets the local directory for app data. That is an adjacent local-path control, not region or residency selection, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
